# TSMP Core 0.2.0

The next non-prerelease minor version after 0.1.0, focused on synchronization correctness and runtime stability. Includes the ordinary Unity support introduced in 0.2.0-beta.1 and all subsequent fixes.

## Fixes and improvements

- Improve humanoid Continuous interpolation with local rotation targets and cached received-ancestor lookup, including skipped parents and root rotation handling. Thanks to @AYANO-TFT for PR #1.
- Give each decoder binding its own received array buffer, preventing one variable or recipient from overwriting another.
- Fix duplicate automatic encoding in the Unity Editor without UdonSharp.
- Reapply discrete BlendShape values when animation or another script has changed the renderer since the previous packet.
- Fix Animator packet sizing and array bounds. Enforce a maximum of 255 parameters and 255 layers per packet, including Inspector selection limits.
- Preserve pending native Encoder RPCs when frame construction or output fails. Consume repeat counts only after successful output.
- Scope RPC duplicate detection by Stream ID so independent streams can reuse event IDs.
- Reserve existing Network IDs before assigning new IDs or resolving duplicates.
- Refresh binding, Animator parameter, humanoid rig and codec caches after configuration changes, including same-length replacements.
- Preserve configured codec instances when Setup adds, removes, reorders or reparents codecs.
- Read actual Timeline playback state in native Unity and add explicit Play, Pause, Resume and Stop methods for Udon state tracking.
- Reduce decoder buffer reallocations and binding checks, and use a compact codec query response to reduce Udon bridge calls.

## Included from the beta

- Install and run Core without VRCSDK/UdonSharp in ordinary Unity, including native bindings, encoder, decoder and Windows Mono Player support.
- Use the same Controller prefab and automatic setup preparation in ordinary Unity and VRChat.
- Preserve existing Controller references through the Legacy prefab.
- Update English, Korean and Japanese documentation and add repeatable regression and integration validation.

## Installation and compatibility

- VRChat: add https://vpm.kiba.red/ to VCC, then install or update TSMP Core and TSMP Codec Luma4.
- Ordinary Unity: install the Core and Luma4 packages through UPM. VRCSDK/UdonSharp is not required for this path.
- Use Luma4 0.0.3-beta.3 or newer for the shared SDK-neutral codec template.
- Protocol bytes and codec IDs are unchanged. Allow Unity and UdonSharp to recompile after updating.
- In Udon, route Timeline playback through the sync component's Play/Pause/Resume/Stop methods. Direct external Director controls and automatic completion are not reliably observable through the exposed Udon APIs.

## Validation

The release code was verified with Unity 2022.3.22f1, Luma4 0.0.3-beta.3, and VRChat Worlds 3.10.4-beta.2 with bundled UdonSharp:

- Native and SDK configuration regressions, including the combined humanoid interpolation and cache changes.
- Full Udon client compilation and selected Udon VM regression checks.
- Actual GPU encode/decode loopback in the Editor and a built Windows x64 Mono Player, covering Transform, humanoid motion, int/Unicode fields and RPCs.
- Player build succeeded with zero errors and one existing SampleBlockLuma shader warning. Managed stripping was disabled.

Live VRChat playback, SDK world build and IL2CPP were not repeated for the final merged code. No broader compatibility is implied by the package publishing workflow. See Validation~/MAIN-MERGE-RESULTS.md for evidence and reproduction steps.
